scripts.build: npm run build -w @blender-ai/contracts && npm run build -w @blender-ai/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @blender-ai/contracts && npm run lint -w @blender-ai/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @blender-ai/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @blender-ai/backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @blender-ai/contracts && npm run test -w @blender-ai/backend && python3 -m unittest discover -s apps/blender_addon/tests -p 'test_*.py'
